I’ll use the Black Huxwrx Flow 556K Sound suppressor as an example.

These are the first few lines of code:

“f8e4f114d51be3084526ebdd”: {

},

“Ergonomics”: -14,**
“Loudness”: -23
},

It seems that the override properties functions also overrides any changes that are made in the realism compatibility patch.

So in the included Realism patch for the 556K when it reads this:

“f8e4f114d51be3084526ebdd”: {
“ItemID”: “f8e4f114d51be3084526ebdd”,
“Name”: “huxwrks_flow_556k_blk”,
“ModType”: “”,
“VerticalRecoil”: -2,
“HorizontalRecoil”: -10,
“Dispersion”: -19,
“CameraRecoil”: -10,
“AutoROF”: 1.9,
“SemiROF”: 3,
“ModMalfunctionChance”: -18,
“CanCycleSubs”: false,
“Accuracy”: -7,
“HeatFactor”: 1.15,
“CoolFactor”: 1.06,
“DurabilityBurnModificator”: 1.18,
“Velocity”: 0.85,
“RecoilAngle”: 0,
“ConflictingItems”: [],
“Ergonomics”: 0,
“Weight”: 0.34,
“Loudness”: -36,
“Convergence”: 0,
“LoyaltyLevel”: 0,
“Price”: 0
},

Because the override properties function takes priority instead of the Suppressor having no Ergonomics Penalty, it will have a -14% ergonomics penalty because that is what is included in the override function.

If anybody is having issues with this as well, I think the solution is to remove all the properties of the weapon in the Override Properties function that affect the weapon’s stats. So for the 556K here is the code that works with the Realism Patch:

“f8e4f114d51be3084526ebdd”: {
“itemTplToClone”: “5dfa3d2b0dee1b22f862eade”,
“parentId”: “SILENCER”,
“handbookParentId”: “MOD_SUPPRESSOR”,
“overrideProperties”: {
“ExaminedByDefault”: true,
“Prefab”: {
“path”: “Mods/AR15/huxwrks_flow_556k_blk.bundle”,
“rcid”: “”
}
},

Make sure to delete the first comma under or after “rcid”. Now the game defaults to using the properties of the Realism patch if Epic’sWeaponPack loads before the Realism mod.

I don’t know if I’ll take out these values for the whole mod, but I just wanted to flag it for the devs.
